name: Can I prevent future toilet leaks after a repair?

mainEntity.name: Can I prevent future toilet leaks after a repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: While some leaks are unpredictable, you can take steps to minimize the risk of future toilet leaks. Regularly inspect the toilet's base for any signs of moisture, check the integrity of the wax ring every few years, and ensure the bolts securing the toilet to the floor are snug, but not overtightened. Periodically inspect the supply line and shut-off valve for wear or corrosion. Avoid using harsh chemical drain cleaners that can damage pipes. Regular maintenance and prompt attention to minor issues can significantly reduce the likelihood of major leaks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent future toilet leaks by regularly checking the base, wax ring, and supply line, ensuring secure bolts, and avoiding corrosive drain cleaners.
